note: Fictional demo content for the open-source launch film. Stages are written in order by scripts/capture-launch.mjs into an isolated database.

goals.title: Find my first 10 customers
goals.milestone: By January 31: ten customers using it every week.
goals.constraints:
No paid ads.

Learn from real conversations first.

strategies.title: Customer conversations
strategies.body: Interview potential users and compare their needs.

decisions.title: Who should we interview first?
decisions.body:
Pick one audience for our first five conversations.

We can interview **five people** this week.

- Solo founders reply faster and can buy on their own.
- Small product teams show where shared decisions slow down.

Starting with one audience keeps the answers comparable.

options.label: Solo founders
options.detail: Start with people who can try and buy on their own.

options.label: Small product teams
options.detail: Learn where shared workflows create friction.

decisions.title: Which problem should we explore first?
decisions.body: Focus the interviews on one recurring pain.

decisions.title: Is this interview invitation ready to send?
decisions.body: Review the message before we contact anyone.

decisions.title: Which feedback should we validate next?
decisions.body: Choose the strongest signal for a follow-up.

strategies.title: Build in public
strategies.body: Test the message through posts and demos.

decisions.title: Which angle should our first post lead with?
decisions.body: Choose the idea readers should remember.

decisions.title: Which product moment should the demo show?
decisions.body: Keep the first clip focused on one useful moment.

decisions.title: Is this launch teaser ready to publish?
decisions.body: Review the draft and product footage together.

decisions.title: Which reader question needs a follow-up?
decisions.body: Pick the next topic for a concrete example.

strategies.title: Validate the offer
strategies.body: Learn what people would sign up and pay for.

decisions.title: Which promise should lead the landing page?
decisions.body: Choose the clearest reason to try it.

decisions.title: What should early access include?
decisions.body: Choose the first offer we can deliver well.

decisions.title: Who should onboarding focus on?
decisions.body: Focus the first experience on one familiar use case.

decisions.title: What should count as buying intent?
decisions.body: Agree on the signal before comparing results.

goals.title: Hold a 10-minute conversation in Japanese
goals.milestone: By June 30: talk with a native speaker without switching to English.
goals.constraints:
Up to 30 minutes on weekdays.

Practice speaking more than reading.

strategies.title: Daily speaking practice
strategies.body: Speak out loud every weekday, even for five minutes.

decisions.title: Which practice fits your weekday mornings?
decisions.body: You have 20 minutes before work.

decisions.title: Start with travel or everyday topics?
decisions.body: Your first conversation partner lives in Osaka.

strategies.title: Weekly tutor sessions
strategies.body: One live conversation with a tutor every week.

decisions.title: Which tutor should we book first?
decisions.body: Both have openings next week.

strategies.title: Learn from shows you enjoy
strategies.body: Pick up natural phrases from podcasts and dramas.

decisions.title: Which podcast should replace your commute playlist?
decisions.body: Both use everyday spoken Japanese.

goals.title: Run my first half marathon
goals.milestone: By April 12: finish the Riverside Half.
goals.constraints:
Run at most four days a week.

Protect my knees.

strategies.title: Build weekly mileage
strategies.body: Add distance gradually with one long run each week.

decisions.title: Which training plan fits your schedule?
decisions.body: Race day is 21 weeks away.

decisions.title: Long run on Saturday or Sunday?
decisions.body: Pick the day you can protect most weeks.

strategies.title: Strength and mobility
strategies.body: Two short sessions a week to protect your knees.

decisions.title: Which strength routine should we start with?
decisions.body: Both take 20 minutes and need no gym.

strategies.title: Race-day plan
strategies.body: Pace, fuel and gear decided ahead of time.

decisions.title: Register at the early-bird price now?
decisions.body: The early-bird price ends Friday.

decisions.title: Which shoes should you train in?
decisions.body: Your current pair has about 500 km on it.

suggestion.title: Add a strategy for founder communities?
suggestion.body:
I studied how 12 indie products found their first 10 customers.

- 8 got their first customers from founder communities.
- What worked: sharing a short demo and asking for feedback.

A strategy there would bring people to us, beyond one-to-one outreach.

First step: pick three active communities and draft one intro post.

options.label: Add Founder communities
options.detail: Share the demo where solo founders ask for feedback.

newStrategy.title: Founder communities
newStrategy.body: Share the demo where solo founders ask for feedback.

decisions.title: Which community should we start with?
decisions.body: Two communities match our first audience.

decisions.title: Lead with a demo or a question?
decisions.body: Members respond best to concrete posts.

decisions.title: Is this intro post ready to publish?
decisions.body: Review the draft before it goes live.
